Appendix 3 — Record Sheets

The original appendix supplies printable forms. This system maps those records to editable sheet sections so no separate PDF is needed.

Original formFields to recordFoundry equivalent
DM's character cardName, class, level, alignment, XP, hp, abilities, weapons, THAC0, magic itemsActor sheet Main, Equipment and Magic Items tabs
Character record sheetAbility adjustments, saves, AC, hp, attack matrix, carried treasure, languagesActor sheet Main, Attack Table and Notes tabs
Spell book sheetSpell name, level, brief description and sourceSpells tab plus spell Items in the Spell compendia
Adventure record sheetDate, roster, monsters, treasure and event logJournal entries and chat log
Hex mapping paperHex grid for wilderness explorationFoundry scene grid (10 ft per hex by default)

Use a JournalEntry for a long-lived adventure log and the actor Notes tab for character-specific secrets and experience notes.

Record Sheets — Tables 1

RecordWhere to keep itUpdate frequency
Character statisticsActor sheetWhen level, XP or equipment changes
Spell bookSpell compendium and Spells tabWhen a spell is learned or prepared
Adventure logJournalEntryAfter each session
Encounter logJournalEntry or chat exportAfter each encounter
